data.title: 莱伊 · 海湾红树林浅滩半蹲追踪猎物的专注凝视
data.action: 半蹲在红树林错综复杂的盘根浅水间，单手撑在湿润树根上保持平衡，另一手抬至眉前挡光远眺海湾深处
data.location: 人迹罕至的亚热带红树林潮汐浅滩沼泽区
data.lighting: 晨曦穿透红树林湿润浓雾，一道道笔直的丁达尔光柱直插浅水，泥沼与树根在逆光中呈现深沉剪影
data.mood: 沉稳机警、荒野猎人的敏锐与毫无杂念的专注
data.description: 潮水悄然退去，红树林根系露出水面。莱伊一身卡其色战术冲浪服，长长的卡特斯双耳警觉地转向不同方位，捕捉着浅滩最微小的声响。她半蹲在浮根上，海水漫过脚踝，目光如鹰隼般扫视着海天交界，低声提醒身侧之人——「保持静止。前方五百米沙洲有热源移动……沙滩度假？等我确认这片海域没有任何感染生物潜伏，再去喝你的冷饮也不迟。」
data.promptProse: Ray crouches barefoot among gnarled mangrove roots rising from a shallow coastal wetland at dawn, wearing a desert-khaki and muted brush-camo neoprene sports bikini with reinforced straps and a wrist rangefinder. Bracing one hand on a damp root while shielding her eyes to scan the horizon, she stands out against golden morning sunbeams piercing the mist.
data.animaCaption: Crouching barefoot atop tangled wet mangrove roots in a khaki brush-camo tactical sports bikini, she braces one hand on the wood and shades her eyes to scan the misty cove. Crisp morning sunbeams slice diagonally through coastal fog across the shallow tide.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a desert-khaki and muted brush-camo neoprene sports bikini with reinforced tactical straps and a wrist rangefinder strap.
